blocks.x: Energy per site down 18% — telemetry-driven optimization at 12,000 sites
A Middle East operator group — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 14-person team over 11 months, Middle East scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Per-site energy uninstrumented; optimization anecdotal; ESG reporting manual.
Site incidents (power, climate, security) found by outage.
Commitment strategy unused; cloud spend escalating.

blocks.x: We instrumented site-level energy and environment telemetry, built the optimization models (load-shaping, equipment scheduling, temperature policies), and delivered the ESG data spine with lineage for disclosure. Site incidents now predicted; cloud commitments rightsized with utilization tracking.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: OEE +7.2 points across 14 plants — sensor fabric to scheduling decisions
Case processing down 52% — document intelligence under accountable-AI gates

blocks.x: Towers: Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering, IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: Achala Twinverse, Achala Forge.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
